en.headline: Blue House lanterns stay lit through Mid-Autumn to 14 October
en.dek: More than 700 hand-painted lanterns hang around the Wan Chai cluster until mid-October, with charity stalls on the open ground through Saturday night.
body: More than 700 hand-painted lanterns remain on display around Wan Chai's Blue House cluster through Mid-Autumn Festival night and until 14 October, with lights on each evening from 6pm to 9.30pm.

St James' Settlement's Viva Blue House project said residents, neighbours, pet owners and about 50 local illustrators painted the lanterns. They hang along Stone Nullah Lane, King Sing Street, Hing Wan Street and nearby shop fronts around the Grade I historic tong lau at 72 to 74A Stone Nullah Lane.

Charity stalls selling handmade Mid-Autumn goods and pet items are set out on the King Sing Street open ground from 24 to 26 September. Organisers asked visitors to keep noise down and stay off private doorways, as households still live in the buildings under the 'retain houses, retain people' conservation approach.

zh.headline: 灣仔藍屋中秋花燈亮至10月14日 今晚續有義賣檔
zh.dek: 逾700盎街坊及插畫家手繪花燈掛滿石水渠街一帶，亮燈至10月中；中秋三晚在景星街空地設慈善攤檔。
body: 灣仔藍屋建築群及附近巷弄的中秋花燈展持續至10月14日，中秋正日晚上同樣亮燈，時間為每晚6時至9時30分，展出逾700盎手繪花燈。
主辦的聖雅各福群會「We嘩藍屋」表示，花燈由灣仔街坊、公眾、寵物主人及約50位本地插畫家共同繪畫，掛於石水渠街772至74A號一級歷史建築藍屋，以及景星街、慶雲街及附近店舖前。
9月24日至26日，景星街8號空地設中秋慈善攤檔，義賣手作及寵物用品。藍屋仍有住戶按「留屋留人」方式居住，主辦單位呼籲賞燈人士保持安靜，勿阻住戶門口。
